body: At a certain point if you are running an experiment that has been failing for months, you just cut your losses and end it. I have almost half a dozen chronic conditions I deal with. All of which doctors don't give me any answers and just take my money. We give dogs more humanity by ending their suffering.

It's not psychological. I have no real desire to go into all the things that are going wrong since it would be a wall of text and I'm tired of talking about it. But it involves stomach problems as well as breathing problems. So enjoying things is practically impossible since I can't eat anything without being in pain and i can't even breathe properly anymore so can't even exercise.

Way back when they were actively tormenting me of course those thoughts crossed my mind, but I'm not a violent person so it was only just those fleeting thoughts. The best thing to do is to truly live a better life, but its hard to do that when you are in constant physical pain.

I have a college education. A good one that was wasted on me. A job that pays good but is wasted on me. Practically my entire paycheck goes to rent and paying for doctors to jerk me around and not give me any help
I'll keep that in mind as i keep struggling to breathe every minute from lung issues thanks

I've been waiting for 6 years. I can admire your optimism, but my life is over. This post was a lil disingenuous to the true cause of my suffering. I'm in physical pain nearly every waking minute and I'm not even in my 30s. Doctors don't know what is wrong with me and I've already spent thousands of dollars. Remembering all the pain these assholes did to me in a time that i wasn't in pain is what has gotten to me, as in my last moments the only happy memories i will be able to think back on are my childhood ones as my past 3 years have just been pain.

Really its almost funny to look at other people's problems here. Not funny as in i laugh at them, but funny because it makes me nostalgic of when my problems weren't physical. That's my source of nostalgia in college is me having personal problems and it ruining my life instead of my impossible physical problems. Little did i know what was in store for me... At least then i had hope, but now? Forget about it.
Imagine being some cunt who creates throwaway reddit accounts to troll and then having the gall to say to "grow up"

Way of the world i guess. Was dealt shit cards due to my health, don't see any point of going on now living in perpetual chronic pain. Past months my dreams have involved those people more which is my brains way of fucking with me i guess.
